name: Telling people how the product works and what changed

failureModes.prompt: Should release notes mention a feature only once it is switched on for the people reading them?
failureModes.why: a feature can ship switched off, and announcing it then sends people looking for something they cannot see

options.label: Only once it is on for them
options.consequence: notes are published a little later, and nobody looks for a missing feature

options.label: When the code is released
options.consequence: simpler timing, and people read about features that are still switched off

failureModes.recommended: Only once it is on for them
failureModes.provenBy: a check before each release that every feature named in the notes is switched on for the people receiving them

failureModes.prompt: Should help text change in the same release as the behaviour it describes?
failureModes.why: help that describes an old screen sends people to buttons that no longer exist, and they contact support instead

options.label: Same release, checked before shipping
options.consequence: one more item on each release, and help never describes an old screen

options.label: Update help afterwards
options.consequence: faster releases, and help is wrong until someone updates it

failureModes.provenBy: a release checklist item, or a test, that fails when a changed screen has help text that was not reviewed in the same release

failureModes.prompt: Should help appear on the screens where people most often need it, or in one separate help section?
failureModes.why: people who must leave their task to look for help can abandon it, and help beside the task is read at the moment it is needed

options.label: Beside the step where it is needed
options.consequence: needs knowing where people stop, and help is shown at the right moment

options.label: One separate help section
options.consequence: simpler to build, and people must leave their task to find it

failureModes.recommended: Beside the step where it is needed
failureModes.provenBy: a walk through the main journey that confirms each step named as hard has help on the same screen

failureModes.prompt: Should new users see what's-new notes about changes made before they joined?
failureModes.why: notes about changes they never saw can confuse new people, who have no earlier version to compare with

options.label: Only people who used the earlier version
options.consequence: needs the last version each person saw, and new people see only current help

options.label: Everyone, once per release
options.consequence: simpler, and new people read about changes that mean nothing to them

failureModes.recommended: Only people who used the earlier version
failureModes.provenBy: a test that signs in a new account and an account from the previous version and asserts only the second sees the notes, once

failureModes.prompt: When a screen changes, should the pictures of it in help be retaken in the same release?
failureModes.why: pictures of old screens make help harder to follow, and refreshing them is work that can be added later

options.label: Retake them in the same release
options.consequence: slower releases, and pictures always match the product

options.label: Refresh them on a schedule
options.consequence: less work per release, and some pictures show old screens for a while

failureModes.provenBy: a dated list of help screenshots compared with the screens they show at each scheduled refresh
